messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager: High 502/5xx rate observed for ALB fronting inference-hosting in euc2 (region euc2b). Severity: P1. Paging on-call.
Monica (oncall): Acknowledged. Going to eyeball dashboards + recent deploys.
Monica (oncall): initial symptom: ~15% of requests returning 502s from edge -> ingress. Latency spikes too. Route53 weighted routing shows sudden shift in euc2 traffic.
Matt SRE: I'm pulling ALB metrics now. 502 spike correlates with high connection resets from Envoy pool on ingress nodes. Backend target group healthy count is unstable.
Matt SRE: `aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:... | jq .` shows a flurry of `unhealthy` -> `initial` transitions.
Eva Infra: Any recent infra changes in euc2? I see a nodepool autoscale event 6m ago in euc2b and a kube-proxy bump.
Deploy Bot: Deploy: `service/ingress-controller` promoted to euc2 @ 2024-10-09T12:12Z by `alex`. Roll ID: roll-20241009-5.
Monica (oncall): Good catch. Alex, did that ingress controller roll include Envoy config or listener changes?
Alex Eng: The roll was a config tweak to keepalive settings and a small Envoy sidecar runtime bump (libssl upgrade). No target group changes.
Matt SRE: Logs from an ingress pod: ```
[envoy][warning] connection reset by peer during header decode
upstream 10.0.45.12:8080 responded 502
```
Matt SRE: Also seeing NAT gateway flows with many TIME_WAITs -> possible ephemeral port exhaustion on nodes talking to backend model servers.
Monica (oncall): Customer impact? Support, any tickets?
Support Bot: Alert: 24 customer requests failed in the last 10m. Top 3 impacted tenants: tenant-42, tenant-acme, tenant-ml (approx 60% of failures). Error rates by region: EU ~18% error ratio, US ~1%.
Eva Infra: Hypothesis: new Envoy + keepalive changes caused connection reuse behaviour that exposed a conntrack / ephemeral port limit on hosts. ALB is failing when targets report resets.
Tim Platform: Short-term mitigation plan: 1) shift Route53 weights away from euc2 -> reduce traffic, 2) scale ingress pods in euc2 to spread connections, 3) restart kube-proxy on nodes to clear conntrack, 4) increase ALB target group healthy threshold and deregister flapping nodes.
Monica (oncall): I'll handle Route53 weight change. Matt, can you coordinate node restarts / conntrack purge with Eva?
Matt SRE: On it. Running `kubectl get pods -n infra -l app=ingress -o wide` then will `kubectl rollout restart` with a 30s delay between pods.
Matt SRE: Also executing conntrack flush on nodes: ```
for n in $(kubectl get nodes -l region=euc2b -o name); do
  ssh $n "sudo conntrack -F"
done
```
Eva Infra: I will raise the ALB target deregister timeout: `aws elbv2 modify-target-group --health-check-interval-seconds 15 --health-check-timeout-seconds 10 ...` and set deregistration delay to 10s for faster failout. Doing now.
Monica (oncall): Route53 change: reduce weight for euc2 from 60 -> 10, add 90 -> euc1. Executed via change batch (propagates ~TTL seconds). `change-id: Z12345Example` 
Monica (oncall): :white_check_mark: Route53 change submitted. TTLs are 60s for the weighted record so effects should be visible quickly.
Deploy Bot: Note: There was a followup ingress config job 2m after the roll that adjusted keepalive back to previous value in canary-pool, unclear if fully rolled.
Alex Eng: Reverting to previous keepalive (2s -> 30s) in euc2 canary now. Pushing patch.
Support Bot: Incoming customer reports: intermittent 502s for inference endpoints; elevated support volume. Created ticket INC-3456 to track.
Matt SRE: After conntrack flush + restart of 3 ingress pods, 502 rate dropped from 15% -> 3% in 2m. Envoy logs show fewer resets.
Eva Infra: ALB target health stabilized; flapping targets now healthy=80%.
Monica (oncall): Good. Keep monitoring for 15m. Any data about root cause from metrics?
Matt SRE: Correlation: spike started ~2024-10-09T12:10Z right after ingress roll, and the roll appears to have toggled keepalive behavior across nodes so existing long-lived connections were recycled in a pattern that exhausted ephemeral ports + conntrack in kernel, causing upstream resets which ALB surfaced as 502s.
Tim Platform: Customer impact assessment (initial): ~18% error rate for EU requests during peak window (12:10-12:22Z). Estimated affected requests ~12k, unique tenants ~24, severity: degraded for multiple customers but no data loss. Suggested external comms: targeted notice to top impacted tenants + status page update (incident P1-mitigation in progress).
Monica (oncall): Creating status page update and pinging account teams for tenant-acme and tenant-ml.
Monica (oncall): Handoff to Tim Platform for followup and RCA. Tim, you'll take lead for postmortem and follow-up action items?
Tim Platform: Taking handoff. Action items I'll own: 1) RCA doc, 2) Add pre-deploy checks for keepalive/conntrack impact, 3) Improve autoscaler priority for ingress, 4) Run chaos test to validate keepalive rollbacks.
Alex Eng: I'll open PR to set default keepalive back to safe value and add automated canary verification that probes ALB target health during rollout.
Monica (oncall): Final check: current error rate EU is down to 0.9%, request rate stabilized. Support volume decreasing.
Support Bot: Ticket INC-3456 updated: customers notified, CS escalation open.
Monica (oncall): Closing pager for now. Leaving post-incident tasks assigned. Thanks all. :pray: 
Incident Bot: Incident closed (automated) at 2024-10-09T12:28Z. Severity downgraded to P2 pending RCA.
Tim Platform: Will schedule RCA and include timeline + exact metric charts. Expect draft in 24h.
